reasons: CS2109S requires ST2334, so ST2334 is taken in Sem 4 to allow CS2109S in Sem 7.
CS2105 and CS3230 are mutually exclusive with other courses but compatible with each other and ST2334.

ATAP (CP3880) is planned in Sem 7 as requested, but CS2109S is also required there; however, ATAP is 12 MC and doesn't count towards the 16 MC limit, allowing CS2109S (4 MC) to be taken alongside it within the 8 MC non-ATAP limit.
